resource_concurrency_rule: One medium/high-memory quantum-chemistry job at a time

WP1.scientific_scope: P09-B ordinary physical-state cyclobutadiene multireference robustness
permitted_methods: Quantum Package v2.2.2 CIPSI+PT2 primary high-level anchor
pre_run_conditions: Freeze reviewed Cartesian inputs and hashes
Seal a blind calculation bundle without V0.1 target values or signs
Record charge, multiplicity, basis, frozen core, orbitals, roots, weights, thresholds and random seeds
Apply the WP1 24-hour/12-GiB/40-GiB first-run resource limits
prohibitions: Do not use WP1 to automatically upgrade P09-A
Do not choose methods or roots by proximity to the monograph value
Do not discard failed roots or convergence attempts

WP2.boundary: The functional energy smoke passed, but Psi4 DIRECT DFT executed a DF backend and exact PK was resource-inappropriate for the largest anchor; ORCA is absent. No eight-anchor completion is claimed.

permitted_methods: Ordinary closed-shell RKS Hessian and force projections
Hessian eigensubspace identification and principal-angle comparison
pre_run_conditions: Retain the frozen Gate V2-0 seeds and hashes
Freeze D6h Cartesian geometry, displacement grid and method before the first energy
Seal a blind calculation bundle without V0.1 target signs
Apply singular-value and root-overlap failure thresholds of 0.90
Apply the WP3 2-hour-per-displacement and 48-hour-grid first-run limits
prohibitions: Do not replace or rotate the preregistered seed after seeing Hessian results
Do not force one-to-one eigenvector matching in degenerate or near-degenerate subspaces
Do not claim nuclear-repulsion dominance from E_N magnitude alone
Do not automatically upgrade P10-A from a P10-B result
